record.edic_text:
835 aulizomai {ow-lid'-zom-ahee}

middle voice from 833;; v

AV - lodge 1, abide 1; 2

1) to lodge in the court-yard, esp. at night
   1a) of flocks and shepherds
2) to pass the night in the open air
3) to pass the night, lodge
